key_findings: Chronic NTG and CSD reduce neuronal complexity in headache-processing regions; HDAC6 inhibition by ACY-738 restores complexity, reverses allodynia and reduces CSD
CGRP receptor antagonist olcegepant also restores NTG-reduced neuronal complexity
